Here's the rewrite. I put the replacement first since that's what she most needs to know, and I kept the apology to one mention of each thing: the battery and the slow reply. Every fact and commitment from the original is still there.

<final>
Subject: Your Pedalpath Metro 2 battery replacement

Dear Ms. Alvarez,

Your Metro 2 is covered by our 2-year warranty, so we're sending you a replacement battery at no cost. We'll email you the tracking details as soon as it ships.

Thanks for writing to us. I'm sorry the battery stopped charging after only five months, and sorry for how long it took us to get back to you. That's not the experience we want you to have.

If you have any questions in the meantime, just reply to this message.

Kind regards,
[Your name]
Pedalpath Customer Support
</final>
